title: measure: what `record:alert` binds, and what still breaks it, at objectui pin 190fbd01d (no source change)
body:
Part of #9167 — **measurement only**. The diff is empty by construction (a single empty commit so the PR can exist); no file in this repo or in objectui was edited. The card stays open: the authoring change this measurement unblocks is deliberately **not applied here** and is the PM's to rule on.

## TL;DR — four readings, two of them reversing the previous round

1. ⛔ **The strike on steps 2–3 is NOT stale. It reproduces exactly at today's pin.** Applying a `has()` guard *in place* to `properties.visible` still turns a correctly-hidden banner into a permanently-visible one, on both pages, with `"has" is not a function` in the console (D1, D2). Screenshot-confirmed: "Email not verified" rendered directly above the page's own "Email Verified: ✓ Yes" chip. **Leave steps 2–3 struck.**
2. ⭐ **`record:alert` now honours the node-level `visibleWhen` gate** — the thing that was measured *inert* on 2026-08-20. `visibleWhen: {cel,'false'}` on the banner now HIDES it (E1), where the same probe did nothing before.
3. ⭐ **Node-level `visibleWhen` binds `record` and `ctx.user`**, polarity-correct on both pages (F1/F2, G4/G5/G6b) — objectui `c86185eb5` observed working through the vendored bundle, not inferred from its title.
4. ✅ **The follow-up the card actually wants is now measured SAFE** — but only in the shape "move the predicate to `visibleWhen` (CEL) **and remove it from `properties.visible`**", with `has()` guards. Every leg green, including forced-sparse and a no-flash check. Not applied; see "What I recommend".

## Environment

| what | value |
|:--|:--|
| framework | `origin/main` @ `281069522`, dedicated worktree, `turbo build` → `Tasks: 71 successful, 71 total` |
| console bundle | rebuilt from the repo's pin: `✓ @objectstack/console dist ready (49388 KB) from objectui@190fbd01d061`, with `✓ Bundle canary 'import/jobs' present` and `✓ Console bundle carries THIS tree's @objectstack/spec, and only it` |
| pin ancestry | verified **in this run**: `c86185eb5237a79d…` *"Bind `record` into node-level `visibleWhen`, and stop `visible` swallowing it (#5505)"*, Fri Aug 21 08:09:49 2026 — `git merge-base --is-ancestor c86185eb5 190fbd01d` → **true**. The clone is shallow and answers `Not a valid object name` first; re-run after `git fetch --depth=400`. |
| server | `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin -p 39167` on its own sqlite file, 48 plugins, 132 seed rows |
| browser | Playwright 1.62.1 driving **chromium-1194** from `PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH` via an `executablePath` override (the bundled 1.62 expects build 1234; ⛔ `playwright install` was not run) |
| method | every mutation is a **network-response rewrite** (page metadata and/or the detail read) against the shipped, unmodified bundle — so each result is an observation of the pinned renderer, not of a tree I built |

## What the block binds today (question 1)

The console's detail read is `GET /api/v1/data/<object>?populate=…&top=1&filter=["id","=",<id>]` — **no `$select`** — and it projects everything:

| object | declared fields | keys returned | only absent declared field | nulls materialised as present keys |
|:--|--:|--:|:--|--:|
| `showcase_task` | 25 | 25 | `__search` | 9 |
| `sys_user` | 26 | 25 | `__search` | 9 |

Both gate fields (`status`, `email_verified`) are present. So the sparse case is not reachable on the ordinary path — it had to be **forced** by rewriting the response, which is what the C and G runs do.

On the wire (`/api/v1/meta/page`, 34 pages served): **exactly 2 `record:alert` blocks exist**, the two on this card, and **both carry `visible` as a bare string with no `visibleWhen`** — `showcase_task_detail` at `regions[0].components[1]`, `sys_user_detail` at `slots.alerts[0]`. The two are identical on every dimension tested; the earlier "one is a `{dialect:'cel'}` envelope" claim stays falsified at this pin. Separately, all **6** authored `visibleWhen` values served are `{dialect:'cel'}` envelopes and **0** are bare — i.e. an author writing a bare string into `visibleWhen` gets CEL for free.

## Runs

Every "hidden" verdict is paired with a mount of the same shape that must SHOW, and every run carries a page-render control. `patched` / `keysRemoved` are the interception counters proving the rewrite was live.

### Baselines — both banners are correct today (unmodified)

| run | page / row | verdict | expected |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| A1 | task `in_review` | **VISIBLE** | VISIBLE ✅ |
| A2 | task `todo` | hidden | hidden ✅ |
| B1 | `sys_user` self, `email_verified=false` | **VISIBLE** | VISIBLE ✅ |
| B2 | `sys_user` self, `email_verified` forced `true` (15 keys set) | hidden | hidden ✅ |

### Fault direction on `properties.visible` (question 2) — fail-SOFT, observed

| run | probe | verdict |
|:--|:--|:--|
| H1 | `visible: "MARKER9167NOSUCHIDENT == 1"` on a `todo` task | **VISIBLE** — console: `Failed to evaluate expression: ${MARKER9167NOSUCHIDENT == 1} … is not defined` |

An unevaluable `properties.visible` leaves the banner rendered. objectui#4807's reading — 「fail-soft 使作者门控的横幅永远显示」 — holds at this pin.

### Forced-sparse, unguarded — still `false`, still hidden

| run | probe | verdict |
|:--|:--|:--|
| C1 | task `in_review`, `status` stripped from the read (6 keys removed) | hidden ✅ |
| C2 | `sys_user` self, `email_verified` stripped (2 keys removed) | hidden ✅ |

Bare strings run on objectui's legacy JS evaluator, where a missing key is `undefined` and `undefined == 'in_review'` is plain `false`. The #8990 absent-key **fault** class still does not reach this surface. The card title's attribution stays falsified.

### ⛔ The struck step 2, executed literally — still harmful

| run | probe | verdict | expected |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| D1 | `todo` task, `visible: "has(record.status) && record.status == 'in_review'"` | **VISIBLE** | hidden ❌ |
| D2 | verified user, `visible: "has(record.id) && has(record.email_verified) && …"` | **VISIBLE** | hidden ❌ |

Console on both: `Failed to evaluate expression … "has" is not a function`. Fail-soft turns that throw into a shown banner. D2's screenshot is the "Email not verified" banner sitting above "Email Verified: ✓ Yes". **Steps 2–3 stay struck; nothing about `c86185eb5` touched this path.**

### ⭐ The node-level `visibleWhen` gate — inert on 2026-08-20, live now

| run | probe | verdict | reads as |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| E1 | `in_review` task (baseline VISIBLE) + `visibleWhen: {cel,'false'}` | hidden | the gate is **honoured** — the 2026-08-20 probe of this exact shape changed nothing |
| E2 | `todo` task, `visible` dropped + `visibleWhen: {cel,'true'}` | VISIBLE | paired mount: the gate can SHOW, so E1 is the gate and not a dead block |
| F1 | `todo`, `visible` dropped + `visibleWhen: {cel,"record.status == 'in_review'"}` | hidden | `record` **binds** into the node gate |
| F2 | `in_review`, same | VISIBLE | polarity-correct pair |
| E3 | `todo`, `visibleWhen: {cel,'true'}` **and** the authored `visible` left in place | hidden | the two gates compose as **AND** — a `visibleWhen` does not rescue a false `properties.visible` |

E3 is the operationally important one: a migration must **remove** `properties.visible`, not just add `visibleWhen` beside it.

### `has()` on the `visibleWhen`/CEL face — works, and is load-bearing

| run | probe | verdict |
|:--|:--|:--|
| G1 | `in_review`, `visibleWhen: has(record.status) && record.status == 'in_review'` | VISIBLE ✅ |
| G2 | same + `status` stripped from the read (5 keys removed) | hidden ✅ — the guard holds |
| G3 | same but **unguarded** + `status` stripped (4 keys removed) | **VISIBLE** — `[object-ui] A conditional predicate failed to evaluate and was treated as its safe default (true) … Reason: [runtime] No such key: status` |
| G4 | verified user, guarded `visibleWhen`, `visible` dropped | hidden ✅ |
| G5 | unverified self, same predicate | VISIBLE ✅ |
| G6b | another user's record, same predicate (control: that page's own title) | hidden ✅ |
| I1 | `todo`, guarded `visibleWhen` only, polled every 150 ms for 8 s | never visible — **no flash** |
| I2 | polling control: unmodified `in_review` page | hidden → VISIBLE at 1414 ms — the poller does see banners |

G3 is the warning label on the whole migration: on the CEL face a missing key **is** a fault, and that face is fail-soft too — so moving a predicate to `visibleWhen` **without** `has()` re-arms exactly the bug this card feared, on a surface that previously could not have it. G4/G5/G6b show `ctx.user` binds there as well (a fault on that half would have fail-softed G4 and G6b to VISIBLE; both are hidden).

## Controls, stated (zero-hit discipline)

- Every negative reading is paired: A1↔A2, B1↔B2, E1↔E2, F1↔F2, G1↔G2, G4↔G5↔G6b, I1↔I2.
- Every run asserts a page-render control string from **that** page. The first G6 run failed its control (it used the other page's title) and was discarded and re-run as G6b rather than reported.
- Interception counters are reported per run: `metaPatched=1` proves the metadata rewrite reached the `record:alert` node; `keysRemoved`/`keysSet` prove the payload rewrite touched real rows. A zero there would have invalidated the run.
- Banner detection is via `[role="status"] / [role="alert"]` node text, cross-checked against a body-text detector, and it is demonstrated live in both directions in the same session.

## What I recommend the PM rule

**Do not lift the strike; retire it and replace it.** Steps 2–3 as written stay wrong forever — they target `properties.visible`, whose evaluator has no `has()` and never will. What changed is that a *different*, better remedy became available, and it is now measured green end to end:

> On both pages, move the predicate off `properties.visible` and onto the component's declared `visibleWhen`, adding `has()` guards, and **delete the `visible` key** in the same edit.
>
> - `examples/app-showcase/src/ui/pages/task-detail.page.ts:51` → `visibleWhen: "has(record.status) && record.status == 'in_review'"`
> - `packages/platform-objects/src/pages/sys-user.page.ts:79` → `visibleWhen: "has(record.id) && has(record.email_verified) && record.id == ctx.user.id && record.email_verified == false"`

Four axes, as the escalation form requires:

- **Real business need — weak, and I will not inflate it.** Zero users hit this today: the detail read projects every declared column on both objects, and the legacy evaluator answers the sparse case `false`, which is the correct verdict anyway. The pull is authoring coherence, not a live bug.
- **Long-term soundness — this is where it wins.** It removes a dialect fork instead of adding one: the same declared slot, the same CEL engine, the same `has()` semantics every other predicate face was migrated to. It is also the downstream half the maintainer's 2026-08-20 ruling 「A 让 record:alert 认 visibleWhen(推荐)」 already ordered; the upstream half has landed and the pin carries it.
- **Hard to get wrong for AI-written metadata — decisive, and it still runs backwards today.** An author who writes the sloppy bare `visible: 'record.x == 1'` gets a silently legacy-evaluated predicate that happens to work; an author who writes the guarded CEL form the platform teaches everywhere else gets a thrown predicate and a permanently-visible banner (D1/D2). Moving to the declared slot makes the correct-looking input the one that works, and a genuine fault there is at least **loud** (G3's warning names the key).
- **Startup scope — cheap and bounded.** Two authored lines, no spec change, no new key, no renderer change; the whole authored surface is exactly the 2 blocks the wire census found.

⚠️ Two conditions I would attach to that follow-up, both measured here rather than assumed: (a) the `visible` key must be **deleted**, not left beside the new gate (E3); (b) the `has()` guards are **mandatory** on the CEL face — unguarded there is strictly worse than today (G3).

## Limits of this run

- Measured as the seeded platform admin, on one read shape, on the two pages this card names. No block-registry census (that was objectui#5401's deliverable, and it is no longer open).
- `email_verified=true` could not be written through the data API (`PERMISSION_DENIED … editable fields: name, image`, ADR-0092), so the verified-user state is produced by rewriting the response — the same mechanism as every other probe here.
- Read from source, used only to explain observations and never as evidence for them: `record-alert.tsx`, `predicateInput.ts`, and the pinned `record-alert.visibleWhen.evidence.test.tsx` header at objectui `190fbd01d`.
- No gate union to report: the diff is empty, so `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` derives nothing — *"this branch changes nothing against 'origin/main' (merge base 281069522) — nothing to derive."* Reporting a green gate sha here would be reporting the green of a tree nobody changed. `git status --short` is empty; the tree measured **is** `281069522`.
